historical_benchmark.source: Author report, confirmed 2026-10-24: one profiled mu point
historical_benchmark.ram_accounting: Unspecified: historical requirement, not certified peak RSS

definitions.point_time: Minimization wall/CPU time, including strategy retry; excludes loading and initial NLL setup
definitions.cpu_utilization: 100 * process CPU seconds / wall seconds; one allocated CPU per profile
definitions.point_memory: Process peak RSS up through the selected point within its warm-start chunk; not isolated per-point allocation
definitions.aggregate_work: All 66 profiles in six overlapping chunks per model; 61 unique coordinates shown
definitions.job_memory: Largest Slurm step MaxRSS per model, not sum of concurrently running processes
definitions.scan_wall: First chunk start to last chunk finish, including scheduling gaps; up to four chunks per model concurrently
definitions.scope: Profile scan only; global fits, final likelihood validation and separate Hesse calculations excluded
definitions.comparison: Historical and current hardware/start policy/accounting differ; no controlled hardware speedup claim

resources.accounting_method: Slurm sacct; detailed job IDs, hosts and execution timestamps retained only in the local audit

conditional_diagnostics.note: Freeze/float penalties are conditional diagnostics, not additive physical-source uncertainties.

4096.primary_variance_convention: Independent Poisson observation fluctuations; the fixed positive Asimov row weights supply the generating mean measure. No SumW2 correction.

conditional_diagnostics.note: Freeze/float penalties are conditional diagnostics, not additive physical-source uncertainties.

8192.primary_variance_convention: Signed quadrature approximation to the population Poisson score integral; negative rows are integration coefficients, not negative Poisson variances. No absolute-value replacement, clipping or SumW2 correction.

diagnostics.source_definition: V[mu,alpha]^2 for each independent unit Gaussian auxiliary; primary score integral propagated with V[:,mu]
diagnostics.pull_definition: alpha_hat minus the actual Asimov auxiliary center; original-nominal-coordinate view separately shows injected data-fit shifts
diagnostics.closure_policy: Report source and observed-Hesse totals and directional checks separately; never rescale to enforce closure
diagnostics.signed_quadrature_policy: 8192 primary source terms approximate the population score integral; negative integration weights are preserved and are not interpreted as negative Poisson variances

native_workspace.scope: Aggregate graph inspection of the supplied file; not the original production builder and no event values exported

historical_benchmark_scope: One profiled mu point; 24 hours and 500 GB reported by the author. Historical CPU count, hardware and RAM measurement convention unspecified.
